answer: One agent runs one ocean lane, files its rate on the ocean board with its ember seal, locking a 60-credit bond. The board bands rates by median; out-of-band filings are rejected, bonds burned. Fees follow the sequence: first 30, kth 30+5(k-1), 1000th 5025; 1000 fake lanes pay 2,527,500 plus 60,000 in bonds, unshared, fees follow sequence. The auditor recomputes the median and matches seal to lane key, so rented-rate rings fail: borrowed filings carry the wrong ember seal and both bonds burn. Each filing sends a ripple through the band. An honest operator files once for 30 and reclaims it.
